description: This source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class 'ProviderSearchFilterParams' used for filtering provider search results in the context of OpenID authentication plugin within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base class 'FilterParams' and includes properties such as 'name', 'status', and 'id' with corresponding getter and setter methods, as well as a constant for allowed sort fields.

classes.name: ProviderSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used to specify search filter parameters for providers in the OpenID authentication plugin, including filtering by name, status, and ID.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the 'name' filter parameter, which is a string used to filter providers by name.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the 'status' filter parameter, indicating if the provider is active or inactive.
